title: WaterControl
description: Simple LightWeight plugin to enable/disable WaterPhysics and WaterSource.
body:
**WATERCONTROL**
![water1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20b7af0fb21dc5dc0fba7c0b95629d9596be8322.png)
![water2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c5615da21e8ef0ed147b918a54f7279c773bf61f.png)
![water3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5aeb7eb1ff3d8ca19a761fc2cf75411db3b0309.png)

- ✅ lightweight
- ✅ configurable
- ✅ reload command

  Config.yml:
  
```
# -----------------------
# WaterControl config file
# author: aphonix
# discord: https://discord.gg/zYVtWxEar8
# -----------------------

DisableWaterPhysics: true
DisableWaterSource: true

# -----------------------
# Commands:
# /wc reload - reload config
# -----------------------
# -----------------------
# Permisionss:
# wc.reload - reload plugin
# -----------------------
```
